item: Main's red from the 1 October burst: unused names in a test, three French strings that said flux for lane
summary: Push CI on main (run 6704) failed three jobs: the blocking ruff step on an unused import and loop variable in tests/test_trending_rank_order.py, which skipped the rest of the ubuntu job, and the glossary guard in tests/test_rewalk_b29_fixes.py on three French run-clock strings that wrote flux where the glossary requires voie. The names were removed, the strings reworded (with the pronoun that points back to the lane), and two unsorted import blocks (src/analytics/map_serve.py, tests/test_boot_sequence.py) sorted so the advisory ruff ratchet read 435 against its ceiling of 436 instead of 439 (the push CI's next step after the lint repair); nothing else changed.
